thread:
acme_prod: Hey team - since ~09:10 UTC we're seeing p99 latency for our inference requests jump from ~650ms -> ~3.2s and a couple of failed responses with 503/oom errors. Affects model: redwood/gpt-medium-v2, tenant acme-prod.

acme_prod: p95 is up too (from 420ms -> ~900ms). No config changes on our side. Can provide request ids.

sara_support: Thanks — we're on it. Can you paste 1-2 request ids and the timestamps? Also are these long-context requests (>= 8k tokens) or typical short chats?

acme_prod: req ids: r-5167894351, r-5167894382. Mostly short (avg 600 tokens) but a few long 6–8k.

liam_runtime: I pulled the service logs. NVML shows GPU mem usage high but not full, however fragmentation metric (slab_free_ratio) is low. KV-cache size for this tenant grew ~4x in the last 2 hours. Looks like per-tenant KV growth causing frequent allocations and fallback paths.

devon_sre: We also see elevated cudaMalloc retries in the node traces around 5167894350-5167894400 and increased kernel latency. Likely allocator churn causing stalls at p99.

nina_eng_infra: Quick mitigation options: 1) route tenant to low-memory model variant (quantized) 2) enable temporary per-tenant QPS cap 3) trigger slab compaction on affected nodes. Which do you want first?

acme_prod: Please do 1 and 2 now. We need minimal downtime.

sara_support: On it — routing to redwood/gpt-medium-v2-q4a and applying soft QPS cap 8 r/s for acme-prod. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: routing update applied for tenant acme-prod -> redwood/gpt-medium-v2-q4a (canary 10% -> 100%), QPS cap 8 r/s (soft). :wrench:

liam_runtime: After the reroute, p99 dropped to ~1.1s and p95 to ~520ms. No immediate OOMs; good sign. However slab_free_ratio still low and KV cache growth is ongoing. We should do compaction + smaller longer-term fixes.

devon_sre: Agreed. I'm scheduling a targeted slab compaction on the 3 nodes serving acme-prod to run in a staggered window to avoid full capacity loss. Command we'll run:

```
rdw-allocator compact --nodes node-32,node-47,node-51 --stagger 120s --max-drain 10%
```

sara_support: ETA for compaction start?

devon_sre: Starting in 12 minutes, one node at a time. Expect brief additional tail latency during each compaction step (~200-400ms for affected requests).

acme_prod: Ok. Also curious if we should evict old KV prefixes? We have some large embedding caches from older sessions.

liam_runtime: Yes, TTLs seem misconfigured. Recommend setting prefix eviction for embedding caches older than 48h for this tenant. We'll push a rule:

```
cachectl set-evict acme-prod embeddings --older-than 48h --dry-run
cachectl set-evict acme-prod embeddings --older-than 48h --apply
```

nina_eng_infra: Also filing a follow-up: adjust allocator tuning flags to reduce fragmentation long-term. Proposed patch will change slab_bin_threshold and enable adaptive compaction. Plan: small rollout next week.

acme_prod: Thanks. Any recommended short-term config on client side? Reducing context length helps?

sara_support: Yes - if you can trim history or truncate to last 2–3k tokens for prompts that don't need full context that will reduce KV pressure immediately. We're marking that in the incident notes for your engineers.

devon_sre: After compaction started: node-32 compaction finished -> slab_free_ratio improved from 6% -> 23%, p99 for acme-prod on node-32 returned to ~550ms. We'll proceed with node-47 in 3m.

liam_runtime: We're also enabling a transient fallback policy for low-priority requests to CPU backend to keep critical requests flowing if GPU allocation stalls. Applied to non-interactive jobs only.

acme_prod: Appreciate it — so far telemetry looks better. We'll keep an eye and trim some histories.

sara_support: Next steps we've committed: 1) completed tenant reroute to quantized model (done) 2) soft QPS cap (done) 3) staggered slab compaction (in progress) 4) eviction of embeddings older than 48h (queued) 5) allocator tuning patch (RFC created, schedule next week).

devon_sre: Adding repro/debug notes for eng-runtime: attach nvprof/nsys traces, allocator heap hist before/after compaction, and KV prefix heatmap for tenant. If eng-runtime wants we can snapshot one affected node for deeper alloc trace.

liam_runtime: Please upload traces to /incidents/5167894321/artifacts and tag eng-runtime.

acme_prod: Uploaded a sample request and trace under that path (req r-5167894382).

sara_support: Closing the high-urgency support escalations for now since p99 is within acceptable & no OOMs after mitigations. We'll keep the ticket open until allocator patch lands. :thumbsup: 

acme_prod: Thanks all. We'll follow up if anything recurs. :pray:

deploy-bot: incident-note created: incidents/5167894321 — mitigations: reroute, qps-cap, compaction, eviction queued, allocator-rfc.

sara_support: tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra for postmortem and long-term fixes.

liam_runtime: I'll open an internal follow-up to track allocator rollout and KV TTL default change.

devon_sre: Good job team.
